paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change of different configurations of quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct using SnapKV as the pruning method across various layers. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer', ranging from 'Layer 1-4' to 'Layer 29-32', presented in a linear scale with the following intervals: Layer 1-4, Layer 5-12, Layer 13-20, Layer 21-28, and Layer 29-32. The y-axis is labeled 'Relative Change' with a range from -15% to 5%, also on a linear scale, including a horizontal baseline marked at 0%. There are four lines in the plot: the yellow line (with circular markers) represents 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit', showing a slight increase from around 0% at Layer 1-4 to approximately 5% at Layer 29-32; the red line (with square markers) represents 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit', which begins at around -5% at Layer 1-4 and ends at nearly 0% at Layer 29-32; the light blue line (with circular markers) represents 'RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit', starting close to 0% at Layer 1-4, with a slight increase to around 1% at Layer 29-32; and the dark blue line (with square markers) represents 'RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit', which shows a steady rise from approximately -5% at Layer 1-4 to about 5% at Layer 29-32. A dashed gray line indicates the baseline of '4×tokens, 4-bit' at 0%.
